# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report it privately through GitHub: open the [security advisory form](https://github.com/framerslab/agentos-live-docs/security/advisories/new), or email team@frame.dev. Do not open a public issue, pull request or chat message about a vulnerability.

## Response

A maintainer acknowledges a report within 5 business days and sends an assessment and a plan within 14 days.
